title: Day and Trial Passes: basis for extending a pass's validity
content:
This document states the basis on which staff may extend the validity window of a Day and Trial Passes pass (Single Day Pass, Three-Day Trial Pass, Seven-Day Trial Pass, Weekly Visitor Pass, Monthly Trial Pass, Corporate Guest Pass).

## Rule
Staff may extend a pass's validity by up to that tier's extension maximum number of days, for that tier's extension fee. Alternatively, staff may extend a pass's validity at no charge, up to that tier's weather-policy extension days, where that tier's basis allows a weather-policy extension and the club was closed for weather or an emergency during the pass's original validity window.

### Points of judgement
- An extension under the ordinary, charged basis and an extension under the no-charge weather-policy basis are two separate grounds for extending the same pass; the weather-policy ground applies only where the club was closed for weather or an emergency during the pass's original validity window, and the ordinary charged ground carries no such requirement.
- A tier whose extension maximum and extension fee are both recorded as zero has no ordinary charged extension available to it.
- A tier whose basis does not allow a weather-policy extension has no no-charge extension available to it under that ground, regardless of any club closure.
